rationale: The pain is real and the buyer is well-defined, but evidence volume is insufficient: only a single source forum post corroborates the problem statement, and no willingness-to-pay signal (competitor pricing, AppExchange reviews, job postings) was locatable from available data. The build gates also fail on technical feasibility grounds — a proper Salesforce managed package requires Apex expertise, AppExchange Security Review, and ongoing Salesforce-release compatibility work that is outside the factory's autonomous build capability.
